reason: The README describes a CLI and MCP server for governed AI workflow orchestration, including model fine-tuning, inference routing, evaluations, traces, approvals, and integrations with agent and orchestration frameworks.

summaries.zh: 通过 CLI 和 MCP 管理受治理的 AI 工作流，包括代码模型微调、推理路由、评估、追踪、审批及编排框架集成。
summaries.en: A CLI and MCP server for governing AI workflows with code-model fine-tuning, inference routing, evaluations, traces, approvals, and orchestration framework integrations.

capabilities: Creates and monitors remote model fine-tuning jobs
Manages trained models and model exports
Routes inference through a hosted OpenAI-compatible API
Provides MCP tools for training, evaluations, usage, traces, approvals, and tenant metadata
Installs local Claude Code and Codex telemetry hooks
Initializes orchestration starters for workflow frameworks
